hints: Compare the rpm, the turns per minute, of the motor gear and the output gear. Are they equal?

Teeth pass at the same rate on both gears, so speed depends on size. Output speed = motor speed × motor teeth ÷ output teeth. A big output gear turns slower, but with more torque, or turning force. It's the same trade a bike makes when you change gear.
Use a small 8-tooth output gear and watch both rpm readings. Which gear turns faster now?
